source_evidence.observation: The embedding tool-stage ranker is the dominant ceiling. On the conservative direct hierarchical slice the selected tool was correct for all 164 supported cases and the within-tool operation pairwise top route was correct for 159/164, while the global raw tool top rank was correct for only 947/1116 graph-seed supported cases.

hypothesis: Replacing only the tool-domain embedding ranker with the existing multilingual pairwise reranker can improve cross-language/domain tool ranking while preserving the bounded registered-tool authority surface. The operation stage remains restricted to endpoints of the selected registered tool and keeps its existing pairwise rejection threshold.
architecture: Construct exactly one option per authorized registered tool using only tool name and description.
Score query-to-tool pairs with the existing multilingual pairwise scorer instead of the MiniLM embedding seed.
Use the pairwise backend's own min-score/min-margin boundary; do not use embedding similarity thresholds for this ablation.
Resolve operations only among registered endpoints of the selected tool with the existing operation pairwise backend.
Preserve fail-closed operation abstention and all schema authorization checks.
Do not introduce cross-kind score arithmetic or synthesize tools/endpoints/arguments/fields.

implementation.reason: SchemaPlanner already accepts a generic DecisionBackend for graph_semantic_seed_backend; only benchmark/configuration plumbing and generic telemetry are required.

evaluation.corpus: same fresh v4 1800-case tuning-eligible development corpus
required_diagnostics: tool-stage raw top-tool accuracy overall and by language/tool

selection_policy: Run this first pairwise-tool ablation without tuning its score threshold. Development results may justify a separately preregistered pairwise tool-boundary study; calibration/test data remain untouched.
